name: What is the best type of insulation for garage walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of insulation for garage walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fiberglass batts are standard for open 2x4 or 2x6 stud bays and provide a cost-effective, straightforward thermal barrier. Mineral wool offers greater fire resistance and denser sound dampening, which is beneficial if the garage doubles as a workshop. Rigid foam boards work well for garage doors or shallow wall framing with limited depth. Spray foam creates an airtight seal and high R-value per inch, but it costs significantly more. The best option depends on whether the wall framing is exposed and whether you plan to hang drywall afterward.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fiberglass batts offer the best balance of cost and performance for standard open studs, while rigid foam or mineral wool suits specialized wall depth or soundproofing needs.
